title: Technical Lead ( Telecom Experience)
description:

It caters to connected cars, drones, autonomous mobility, robotics, utilities, energy, fleet management, logistics, medical devices, and manufacturing. Aeris serves over 7,000 enterprise customers and connects more than 115 million devices worldwide, including 41 million connected vehicles, supported by an ecosystem of 30+ mobile network operators. * Aeris Office, Gurgaon, India
* Aeris Office, Noida, India
* Hybrid 3d/wk in office

Technical leadership role in the development of a cloud-based 3GPP compliant 5G SA core network. Communicate daily with the architect and generate detailed technical designs and documentation. * **Team Oversight:** Oversee and support the daily activities of other developers, including mentoring, code reviews, and troubleshooting, ensuring best practices are followed throughout the project.

* **Adoption of New Technologies**: Integrate emerging AI-powered tools and methodologies to enhance development processes.

**Mandatory Telecom domain experience**

Experience in some of the 3GPP Cellular Network Standards like below:

  

* Familiarity with 3GPP Rel 15 and later
* Cellular identifiers (ICCID, IMSI, MSISDN, IMEI)
* 2G/3G (SS7), 4G (Diameter), 5G SA (HTTP/2)
* AAA/RADIUS, SMS, SMPP
* VoLTE
* API Development & Security
* Oath2
* PKI
* mTLS, SSL
* IP networks: packet inspection, routing, IP allocation & assignment, subnets, CIDR specification, IPV6

* AI-powered coding assistants and effective prompt engineering, and use GenAI for technical research and documentation.
* Git source control & release compliance
* Critical thinking
* Excellent communicator: able to effectively express ideas and concepts, in both written and
* spoken forms. Can organize and lead internal discussions and present to customers

**Desirable**

  
Hands-on development experience in any programming language

* - Java, Go, C++, Python, anything. We care that you write real code, not which language you use
* Database (MySQL, Oracle, Cassandra, Redis (at least one)
* Public cloud services: GCP, AWS or Azure
* Agile Scrum Master
* Spring Boot
* Docker/Containers/Kubernetes
* C/C++
* Message broker: RabbitMQ, Kafka, etc

**Education**

BS or higher degree in Computer Science or equivalent

Aeris is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected status.

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1747234

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**EY-Consulting – Data and Analytics – Databricks Architect – Senior Manager**

  

EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.

**The Opportunity**

  

The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.

  

The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

  

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

  

**Skills And Attributes for Success**

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

  

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.

* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.

title: Director, Security
description:
Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India

Engineering & Development

Pay range:

  

BOLD is looking for a **Director of Security** to own security across a large portfolio of client-facing products. Our products run on AWS and Azure, ship at high velocity across UI and backend, and make extensive use of AI and LLMs across the customer experience.

This is a builder's role, not an audit role. You will design security into our architecture, our delivery pipeline and our AI features, and lead the team that keeps it there. Compliance, certifications and penetration testing are part of the remit, but they are outcomes of a well-run program, not the program itself.

We want someone who has already thought hard about what changes when a product talks to a model: prompt injection and hijacking, data leaking through model context, agents with too much authority, and attackers who now use AI too.

**+ What you'll be securing:**

**Layer**

**What we run**

**What we need from you**

**Cloud**

AWS and Azure, multi-account / multi-subscription

One identity, policy and posture model across both clouds

  

**Compute**

Kubernetes (EKS / AKS), containers, CI/CD

Supply-chain integrity, runtime detection, least-privilege workloads

  

**Edge**

CDNs, WAF, bot detection agents

Tuned defences against scraping, credential stuffing and AI-driven bots

  

**APIs**

Public and partner APIs behind API protection

Discovery, schema enforcement, abuse and BOLA/BFLA detection

  

**Applications**

Modern web front ends and backend services

Secure-by-default frameworks and paved roads for engineers

  

**AI**

Extensive use of AI and LLMs in client-facing features

An LLM threat model, guardrails, evals and monitoring in production

**Job Description**
-------------------

**ABOUT THIS TEAM**

BOLD Platform services team design, creates, manage and maintains the highly scalable and distributed services for the wider use of web and mobile product applications/portals/websites. The current list of services is based on Microservices architecture whose domain ranges from visitor tracking, User profiles, authentication, content and payments.

Platform team uses state of the art modern technologies like .Net framework, Python, Java, SQL Server, My SQL, Graph DB, SOLR, and a lot of other tools & technologies serving millions of users with hundreds of million transactions everyday through a scalable and fault tolerant architecture.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* **AI and LLM security:** Own the threat model for every AI/LLM-powered feature, covering prompt injection and prompt hijacking (direct and indirect), jailbreaks, system-prompt and data leakage, insecure output handling, excessive agency in tool-calling, and model denial-of-wallet.
* **AI assurance:** Build adversarial evals and red-team exercises for AI features into the release process, with production monitoring for abuse and drift. Govern internal AI use, including coding assistants, agents with repo or cloud access, plugin integrations and shadow AI.
* **Multicloud security:** Set a unified security architecture across AWS and Azure: identity federation and guardrail policies. Harden Kubernetes with admission control, network policy, workload identity and runtime threat detection.
* **Edge defences and real-time tuning:** Own edge security across every client-facing product, working with Architecture and Technical Operations on real-time tuning of DDoS mitigation thresholds, rate limits, bot-score and challenge thresholds, and WAF rule sensitivity, balancing attacks blocked against false positives for real customers.
* **API security:** Run an API security program covering inventory of every endpoint, authentication and authorization patterns, rate limiting and abuse detection.
* **Secure engineering:** Build paved roads so the secure way is the easy way. Embed SAST, SCA, secrets and IaC scanning and SBOMs in CI/CD, secure the software supply chain, and lead design reviews and threat modelling as a peer to architects.
* **Detection and response:** Own detection engineering and incident response across cloud, Kubernetes, edge and AI layers, including runbooks for AI-specific incidents, tabletop exercises and post-incident reviews.
* **Tooling and budget:** Own the security tooling budget: build business cases, rationalise overlapping tools, negotiate with vendors and track spend against risk reduced. Partner with Architecture and Technical Operations on tooling decisions from evaluation to rollout, and agree who owns which detection thresholds during a live attack.
* **Governance and compliance:** Set direction for governance, risk and compliance, working with our in-house GRC team, which owns day-to-day delivery. Ensure compliance with GDPR, PCI DSS and the EU AI Act is a byproduct of engineering controls, with automated evidence.
* **Risk and assurance:** Make the calls on high-impact third-party risk, especially AI providers. Scope and direct penetration tests and bug bounty, and represent security to enterprise clients on strategic deals.
* **Leadership:** Build and lead a small, high-leverage team (application, cloud and AI security), work closely with our in-house GRC team, grow security champions inside engineering, and report risk posture and program metrics to executive leadership in plain business terms.

**WHAT YOU’LL NEED**

* 12+ years in security, including 4+ years leading a security function in a product engineering organisation with a multi-product, client-facing portfolio, including ownership of its tooling budget.
* Hands-on depth in cloud security on both AWS and Azure; able to read an IAM policy, a Terraform plan and a Kubernetes manifest and spot the problem.
* Practical experience securing AI/LLM-powered features in production, including defending against prompt injection and hijacking.
* Strong application and API security background: OWASP Top 10 and API Top 10, OAuth/OIDC, authorization design and secure SDLC.
* Experience running and tuning edge defences in production (CDN/WAF, DDoS mitigation, bot management and API protection platforms), including threshold tuning during live traffic events.
* Detection and incident response leadership, including at least one serious incident handled end to end.
* Has overseen compliance programs such as GDPR, PCI DSS or EU AI Act readiness alongside a GRC team.
* Comfortable writing code or scripts (Python, Go or similar) to automate, prototype and review.
* Communicates risk to engineers and executives with equal clarity, and earns trust by enabling delivery rather than blocking it.

**WHAT’S GOOD TO HAVE**

* Has built LLM red-teaming or eval harnesses, or contributed to OWASP GenAI, MITRE ATLAS or similar work.
* Experience with AI gateways or LLM firewalls, and with securing agentic workflows.
* Background working alongside data science teams on model and data pipeline security.
* Familiarity with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and the NIST AI RMF.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, OSCP or cloud security specialties (valued, not required).
